LESSON: A FRIEND AT MIDNIGHT

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Life of Jesus
Topic 3.9: A friend at Midnight

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: A friend at Midnight
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How does the parable of a friend at midnight relate to Christians today?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. apply lessons learnt from the parable in day-to-day life

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: apply lessons learnt from the parable in day-to-day life

Teach
• Today’s focus: apply lessons learnt from the parable in day-to-day life.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “apply lessons learnt from the parable in day-to-day life” using a school example.
• Model B for “apply lessons learnt from the parable in day-to-day life” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "apply lessons learnt from the parable in day-to-day life" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: apply lessons learnt from the parable in day-to-day life

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: apply lessons learnt from the parable in day-to-day life

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for A friend at Midnight.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How does the parable of a friend at midnight relate to Christians today?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• apply lessons learnt from the parable in day-to-day life

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
